name: model_op_kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache
description: Fused RMSNorm + RoPE over a fused KV projection with paged cache update (FlagGems-vllm PR #722, kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache). kv [batch, 1, seq_len, 576] float16/bfloat16 splits into an RMS part [0:512] and a RoPE part [512:576]; gamma [512] is the RMSNorm weight; cos and sin are [batch, 1, seq_len, 64]; index [batch*seq_len] int64 gives the flat cache slot per token; k_cache [page_num, page_size, 1, 64] and ckv_cache [page_num, page_size, 1, 512] are the paged caches, updated in place. The RoPE half rotates the interleaved even/odd lanes of the RoPE part against the contiguous first/second halves of cos/sin; the RMS half normalizes by sqrt(mean(x^2) + epsilon) and scales by gamma. Both results are scattered into their caches at index. Scale and offset arguments are None (no quantization) and cache_mode is the paged 'PA_BNSD' layout. With is_output_kv true, returns (k_cache, ckv_cache, k_rope, c_kv); k_cache and ckv_cache are mutated in place and returned by alias. Matches torch_npu.npu_kv_rmsnorm_rope_cache.
